name: Twenty
summary: Open-source CRM with agentic workflows: emails and meetings log themselves, calls can be recorded, and AI can take on CRM chores.
description: Open-source CRM with agentic workflows: emails and meetings log themselves, calls can be recorded, and AI can take on CRM chores.

pricing.details: Self-hosting is offered as a first-class free option. Cloud has a 30-day trial. Pro 8 €/user/month — a custom agentic CRM for one team, limited personal AI usage (officially about 100 AI tasks/week per member, renewed every Monday). Organization 35 €/user/month — everything in Pro plus custom roles, SAML/OIDC SSO and audit logs, priority support, 5× personal AI usage (about 500 AI tasks/week per member). A Yearly −25% toggle is on the page; yearly totals were not itemized and are left unlisted. Credit packs are officially 1 € per credit, from 18 €/month, shared at workspace level when personal usage runs out. Enterprise from 45,241 €/year (talk to sales).
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Open-source CRM with agentic workflows: emails and meetings log themselves, calls can be recorded

Yearly totals besides a −25% toggle were not itemized and are not listed. Self-hosting is free
